cases.name: Christina Lynn Castiglione
cases.about: She was popular and athletic and liked to repair cars, play baseball and kickball. She graduated from Redford Union High School and was active in sports. Christina was not married but had a steady boyfriend. She was employed by the Detroit Edison Company as a clerk in the research department and had recently contacted an Army Recruiter.
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE SOLVED; FORENSIC INVESTIGATIVE GENETIC GENEALOGY SOLVED; SUSPECT DECEASED WHEN ID'D
cases.narrative: On 3/29/1983, her body was found in Livingston County near Fisher and Fawcett roads in the Oak Grove State Game Area.
